plugins.name: sla-guard
plugins.description: Marks a support ticket as within SLA or breached based on a response-time threshold.

plugins.name: access-review
plugins.description: Flags an account for recertification when it has not been reviewed within the allowed window.

plugins.name: refund-guard
plugins.description: Auto-approves a refund under a threshold and routes larger ones to a manager.

plugins.name: payment-fraud-screen
plugins.description: Bands a payment by risk score into approve, step-up authentication, or decline.

plugins.name: pr-size-gate
plugins.description: Gates a pull request by lines changed: auto-mergeable, request review, or split it.

plugins.name: log-retention
plugins.description: Retains, preserves under legal hold, or flags a record for deletion past its retention window.
